title: Replicating CoT Monitoring Across Tool-Calling Formats: JSON vs. Natural Language Tool Calls

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If monitor accuracy depends on output format, this has practical implications for standardization. However, the impact is incremental rather than fundamental - it is a configuration detail rather than a fundamental limitation of monitoring.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires setting up ControlArena with Inspect AI, configuring tool-calling formats, running an 8B agent on tasks, and applying monitoring. The multi-component pipeline (agent + tasks + monitor + format switching) is challenging for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two format conditions on a standard task set is conceptually simple, but the infrastructure setup for ControlArena and Inspect AI could easily consume most of the 30-hour budget.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
